MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The WYZE camera feels relevant because I have bought Foscam and Blink cameras and would consider another camera for an indoor monitoring spot.",
    "The smart plug and Echo Dot offer useful ways to extend Alexa control around my existing Fire TV setup, especially for controlling a lamp or using voice commands hands-free."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire tablets share a familiar brand with my streaming devices, but I have no current need for a portable screen; my television already serves my viewing needs.",
    "The Echo Show adds a screen and video calling that I do not currently need, so I would choose the simpler Echo Dot.",
    "The laptop sleeve, hard-drive case, and earbuds solve needs that my recent purchases do not suggest I have, including owning a device that fits those cases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as broad interest in Amazon devices, even when those devices serve different purposes.",
    "Buying home electronics seems to have been treated as interest in general electronics accessories and personal audio."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated security-camera purchases make home monitoring a clearer ongoing interest than tablets or earbuds.",
    "A useful next purchase needs a specific role in my home setup; shared branding or Alexa support alone does not give me a reason to buy it.",
    "Accessories need to match equipment I actually use, and another screen needs a purpose beyond the viewing setup I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in home monitoring and Alexa control but stretched it into broader device and accessory needs I do not currently have."
}
